notes: Single-attestation, textually contested form: Strong's own headline meaning is "to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in a net", not "roast" -- some scholars read this verse as "the slothful man does not hunt/catch his game" rather than "does not roast it". "Roast" follows the traditional KJV rendering, which many other translations keep; shipped per the person's gloss, dispute flagged since no second citation exists to settle it.
